meta.title: Bing Web Search
meta.description: Switches DSH web search from the DeepSeek official backend to Bing's public endpoints. Every web_search used to be a standalone DeepSeek model request billed against DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, no matter which chat model was selected, so this cuts that billing path entirely: searching stops costing money and stops consuming the chat model's context budget. Keyless, direct from mainland China via cn.bing.com, ~0.8s for 10 results.
